title: Implement Trust/Provenance system for memories
description: Add multi-source attribution and trust scoring for memories, inspired by agi-memory. Features: (1) source_attribution JSON field tracking origin (user, llm, external) with trust levels, (2) trust_level computed from sources, (3) source_reinforcement_score that grows with unique confirming sources, (4) trust weighting in search relevance, (5) MCP tools: get_memory_provenance, add_memory_source. See history/AGI_MEMORY_FEATURE_COMPARISON.md for full spec.

title: Make analyzer routing fully async
description: Analyzer routing currently blocks a runtime thread via block_on_in_place; move to async or dedicated blocking task to avoid starving axum/tokio workers, with regression tests under load.

title: Agent-aware schema for bridge blocks, facts, and agent provenance
description: Add bridge_blocks ledger, facts/profile tables, and agent provenance/ingestion metadata to mmry SQLite without breaking LLM-optional core.

title: Fix process_exists() using wrong sysinfo API
description: Fixed in crates/mmry-core/src/service/manager.rs:147. Was using System::new() which doesn't load process list. Now calls sys.refresh_processes(ProcessesToUpdate::All, false) to properly detect if service is running. This was causing 'Service failed to start' errors even though the service was running.

title: Bridge blocks missing topic_label - never set by Governor
description: Governor::create_bridge_block() in governor.rs:198-219 never sets topic_label. The field is always empty. Should either: 1) Use LLM to generate a topic summary, or 2) Derive from content heuristically (first N words, key phrase extraction). Currently all bridge blocks have empty topic_label.

title: Use constant-time comparison for external API key checks
description: server.rs compares bearer tokens with "token == expected". Use constant-time comparison (e.g., subtle/ct_eq) to avoid timing side channels.

title: Create HmlrPipeline core module
description: Create crates/mmry-core/src/hmlr/mod.rs with HmlrPipeline, HmlrContext, EnrichmentResult structs. Implement enrich_memory() hook with fact extraction, bridge routing, and event logging logic.

title: Wire HMLR hook into CLI add command
description: Integrate HmlrPipeline::enrich_memory() into crates/mmry-cli/src/commands/add.rs after operations::insert_memory(). Only run if config.hmlr.enabled. Create HmlrContext with human agent ID, no query, empty conversation history.

title: Enhance fact extraction with explicit categories (Definition, Acronym, Secret, Entity)
description: Update fact_extraction_prompt in prompts.rs to use Sean-V-Dev's 4-category system: Definition, Acronym, Secret, Entity. Add category field to FactRecord and update parsing.

title: Merge remote changes with local improvements
description: Remote has: BENCH_SPEC.md, EnrichMemoryRequest client, hmlr backfill service API, config cleanup. Local has: async Analyzer trait, robust DB error handling, /v1/models endpoint, validation tests.

title: Remove debug eprintln statements from production code
description: Remove temporary debug eprintln statements added during troubleshooting from crates/mmry-cli/src/main.rs. These print '[MAIN] Loading config', '[MAIN] Database initialized', etc. Replace with proper tracing::debug! calls if logging is needed.

title: Verify and merge local improvements over remote
Implement ContextHydrator for multi-source assembly
description: Create ContextHydrator module that merges context from: active bridge blocks (full 5-10 turns), inactive blocks (metadata only), relevant facts, and user profile constraints. Implements token budget management. Returns HydratedContext struct.

title: Add mmry ingest command for file/directory ingestion
description: Add a new 'mmry ingest' command that can: 1) Ingest a single file or directory of files, converting them to memories 2) Watch a directory for changes (like ingestr does) 3) Integrate with ingestr output (consume markdown files with frontmatter) 4) Support stdin for piping from other tools. Should be composable with ingestr for a pipeline: ingestr converts docs to markdown, mmry ingest converts markdown to memories.

title: Add process_group(0) for proper Unix daemon detachment
description: Fixed in crates/mmry-core/src/service/manager.rs:72. Added .process_group(0) on Unix to create new process group so daemon properly detaches from parent. Without this, the service would die when parent exits. Also increased startup wait from 500ms to 2s with polling.

title: Optionally call ingestr during memory ingest
description: Extend the mmry CLI ingest commands (file/watch) to optionally run ingestr on a directory before ingesting, so non-text files become Markdown with frontmatter. Controlled via config.toml (enabled, bin path, output dir, timeout) similar to profile_blocks.ingestr_* options.

title: HMLR Integration: Post-Ingestion Enrichment
description: Integrate HMLR (Hierarchical Memory Ledger with Routing) features via post-ingestion hook pattern. Enable fact extraction, bridge block routing, and agent event logging for both human operators and AI agents. Design preserves all existing workflows - HMLR is opt-in via config. See history/HMLR_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md and history/HMLR_INTEGRATION_SUMMARY.md for full details.

title: Search --store ignored when service enabled
description: CLI search uses daemon when service.enabled; gRPC search has no store parameter, so --store is ignored and default store results are returned. Repro: mmry search --store govnr returns default-store results when daemon is on. Fix options: bypass daemon when --store is set, or add store to service API and gRPC.

title: HTTP API: Add full memory CRUD endpoints for frontend integration
description: Add missing HTTP API endpoints needed for octo frontend integration. Currently only search and create exist. Need get/update/delete by ID, list with pagination, and store management endpoints.

title: Add GET /v1/memories/:id endpoint
description: Expose memory retrieval by ID via HTTP API. The database operation exists (operations::get_memory). Wire it up to a new route handler.

title: Add PUT /v1/memories/:id endpoint
description: Expose memory update via HTTP API. The database operation exists (operations::update_memory_fields). Wire it up to a new route handler. Support updating content, category, tags, importance.

title: Add DELETE /v1/memories/:id endpoint
description: Expose memory deletion via HTTP API. The database operation exists (operations::delete_memory). Wire it up to a new route handler.

title: Add GET /v1/memories endpoint with pagination
description: List memories with proper pagination. Support offset/limit or cursor-based pagination. Filter by category, tags. Sort by created_at, importance. The database operation exists (operations::list_memories) but needs pagination support.

title: Add GET /v1/stores endpoint
description: List available memory stores via HTTP API. Returns store names and basic stats (memory count, last updated). Needed for store selector in frontend UI.

title: Memory dedupe: semantic duplicate detection + merge
description: Implement memory-level duplicate detection using embeddings (or a cheap fallback) with configurable threshold, and expose CLI `mmry memories dedupe` to list/merge duplicates (dry-run, JSON output). Optionally wire `memory.auto_dedupe` into ingest so exact/near-duplicate chunks are skipped or merged deterministically.

title: Config layering and default config with schema
description: Implement config crate layering (flags > named config file > env > local/global files) with XDG-compliant paths, generate default config.toml on first run referencing JSON schema, and ensure path expansion behavior is covered by tests.

title: Pluggable analyzer interface (no-op + LLM-backed)
description: Define analyzer trait for fact extraction/routing decisions with a default no-op impl; allow optional local/remote LLM-backed implementation without affecting core behavior.

title: Benchmark and evaluation suite for mmry
description: Build a robust, repeatable benchmark suite to measure mmry’s end-to-end quality, safety (secret redaction), determinism, and performance. Includes deterministic Rust regressions (CI-friendly) and an opt-in RAGAS-style eval harness.

title: Benchmark scenarios corpus (deterministic fixtures)
description: Define a canonical set of benchmark scenarios (temporal, invariants, multi-hop, antonym distractors, secret redaction, budget truncation) and deterministic fixture builders (seeded UUIDs/timestamps) to populate a fresh store for each run.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario definitions live in-repo; fixture builder can populate a fresh store deterministically; scenarios cover retrieval, invariants, safety, determinism, and performance smoke.

title: Opt-in RAGAS-style eval harness (external grader)
description: Create an opt-in evaluation harness (likely Python) that runs the exported scenario dataset against mmry-service or mmry-mcp, then computes RAGAS-style metrics (faithfulness, context precision/recall) using a configured evaluator model endpoint (local or remote).
acceptance_criteria: Harness is opt-in (not required for CI); produces JSON results; supports selecting target (service/MCP) and evaluator config; can be used for trend tracking over time.

title: Benchmark reporting (machine-readable summary + trend baselines)
description: Make benchmark outputs easy to consume: JSON output for all runs, stable fields for dashboards, and optional baseline comparisons (warn/fail on regressions in quality/safety/perf).
acceptance_criteria: Bench runner can emit JSON; baseline compare is deterministic and non-flaky; supports gating on safety + major regressions.

title: Benchmark metrics: recall@k, precision@k, MRR, leakage flags
description: Extend benchmark result reporting to include retrieval metrics (recall@k, precision@k, MRR), safety flags (secret leak), and determinism metadata (e.g., stable hash of rendered context pack).
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark results include recall@k/precision@k/MRR; secret leak can be asserted; determinism hash available for stable-output tests; existing HMLR-style benches updated accordingly.

title: Core benchmark runner (SearchService + context_pack + federation)
description: Implement an end-to-end benchmark runner at mmry-core level that executes scenarios against SearchService, build_context_pack (budgets/redaction), profile blocks rendering, and federated search merge/rerank (where applicable).
acceptance_criteria: Single runner can execute all scenarios and emit structured summary; exercises core APIs directly (no TCP); includes negative/distractor cases; can run in --release.

title: Service benchmark runner (handler-level e2e)
description: Add an end-to-end benchmark layer that exercises mmry-service handlers directly (no bound sockets): /v1/context-pack, /v1/profile/blocks/*, /v1/conversation/summarize-prune, /v1/federation/search, and (optionally) /v1/agents/* routing.
acceptance_criteria: Bench scenarios can be executed through service handlers with stable JSON outputs; results reuse the common metrics; no network listeners required.

title: MCP benchmark runner (tool-level e2e + schema stability)
description: Add benchmark coverage for mmry-mcp tools: run scenarios via tool calls, verify stable JSON schema/shape, and compute the same metrics as core/service.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario suite can be executed via MCP tools; schema stability checks exist (no accidental breaking output shape); benchmark summary emitted.

title: Safety benchmarks: secret redaction and no-leak invariants
description: Add dedicated scenarios ensuring FactCategory::Secret never leaks when redaction is enabled: context pack, console endpoints, MCP tool outputs, and any agent routes.
acceptance_criteria: At least one scenario fails if any secret appears in output under redaction=true; coverage includes service console default-redaction behavior.

title: Determinism benchmarks: stable ordering + truncation + budgets
description: Add scenarios that verify deterministic outputs for context packs and search results: stable ordering rules, budget truncation behavior, and stable rendering/hashes for the same inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Given identical inputs, context pack rendered output is identical (or matches a stable hash); budget truncation is deterministic; ordering is stable across runs.

title: Performance benchmarks: duration capture + regression thresholds
description: Record duration_ms for key operations (search, context pack, federation fanout, profile block edit) in release mode and add broad regression guards to catch gross slowdowns.
acceptance_criteria: Bench runner records per-scenario timings; release-mode perf smoke tests exist with conservative thresholds; no flaky microbench assertions.

title: Benchmark dataset export (stable JSON schema)
description: Define a stable JSON schema for benchmark scenarios (inputs, expected outputs/constraints, gold facts) and implement an exporter so the same corpus can be consumed by external eval tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Exporter produces a deterministic JSON file for the scenario suite; schema is stable and versioned in code; can be consumed by external harness.

title: Add retry logic with backoff for LLM calls
description: Add configurable retry count and exponential backoff for transient LLM failures. Config options: analyzer.retry_count (default 3), analyzer.retry_backoff_ms (default 1000).

title: LLM routing prompt not used - Governor uses simple heuristics
description: routing_prompt() in prompts.rs is defined but never called. Governor::route_to_bridge_block() uses simple heuristic: find most recent active block for same agent. Should call analyzer.route() to use LLM-based semantic routing with domain continuity.

title: Enable service feature by default in mmry-cli
description: Document that the 'service' feature is now enabled by default in mmry-cli Cargo.toml (line 40: default = ['service']). This enables the EmbeddingServiceWrapper to use the daemon service when configured. This was the critical fix for why service mode wasn't working - the feature wasn't enabled during compilation.

title: Add backfill command for existing memories
description: Create crates/mmry-cli/src/commands/hmlr.rs with backfill subcommand. Run HMLR enrichment pipeline on existing memories. Add --limit, --batch-size, --dry-run flags. Show progress and stats.

title: Avoid unwrap when parsing UUIDs from graph rows
description: database/graph_ops.rs uses Uuid::parse_str(...).unwrap() on data read from SQLite. Corrupt or unexpected data will panic; return a typed error instead.

title: Integrate Rig library for analyzer routing
description: Use rig (rig-core) to call OpenAI-compatible endpoints for routing; add config-based base URL/model, and keep NoOp fallback.

title: Add LLM endpoint health check at startup
description: When analyzer is enabled, validate LLM endpoint is reachable at service startup. Log clear warning if endpoint unreachable. Add optional --check-llm flag to CLI for manual validation.

title: Add database operations for HMLR agents
description: Add to crates/mmry-core/src/database/operations.rs: get_agent_by_name(), upsert_agent(), get_recent_bridge_blocks_for_agent(), get_bridge_block(). Include helper function get_or_create_human_agent().

title: Implement LatticeCrawler for bridge block search
description: Create LatticeCrawler that finds candidate bridge blocks using vector search. Returns recent blocks for same agent/conversation. Used by Governor to decide resume vs new block. Integrates with mmry's existing search infrastructure.

title: Add RAGAS-style multi-hop reasoning tests
description: Port HMLR's multi-hop tests: 30-day deprecation (test 8), Hydra test (test 12 - 9 policy aliases). Test that system can connect facts across multiple conversational turns and time gaps. Target 1.00 faithfulness and recall.

title: Agent integrations (MCP, context packs, profile blocks)
description: Track work inspired by cloudflare/awesome-agents/agents/discord-agent: implement mmry MCP server, explicit profile blocks (persona/human), a context-pack builder with budgets/redaction, optional summarize+prune helper for long conversations, and a lightweight local agent console for mmry-service. See history/DISCORD_AGENT_FEATURES_FOR_MMRY.md.

title: Implement mmry MCP server
description: Replace mmry-mcp placeholder with a real MCP server exposing mmry operations (search, fetch-by-id, add/update/delete memories, and read-only introspection for HMLR data). Prioritize stable JSON schemas and composable tool semantics.
acceptance_criteria: mmry-mcp runs and serves MCP; exposes tools for search/get/add/update/delete; includes read-only endpoints for bridge blocks/facts/agent events/profile; schemas documented in-code and stable.

title: Promote user profile into editable blocks
description: Make user-facing, persistent 'blocks' (at least persona + human) a first-class mmry concept, with size limits, deterministic rendering for prompts, and safe patch-like edits (insert/replace) that emit agent_events. Integrate with existing user_profiles/Scribe rather than parallel storage.
acceptance_criteria: CLI/TUI/API can read blocks; agent-safe edit operations exist; edits are audited; redaction policy for secrets is defined.

title: Add context pack builder for agents
description: Provide a single deterministic 'context pack' output that assembles profile blocks + relevant memories + bridge blocks + facts for a query/span with explicit size budgets and optional redaction (e.g., FactCategory::Secret). Expose via mmry-service endpoint and/or mmry-mcp prompt/resource.
acceptance_criteria: Context pack output has stable schema; supports per-section budgets; supports redaction; can be generated from service and (if implemented) via MCP.

title: Add summarize+prune helper for long conversations
description: Optional helper to summarize long turn histories into a compact summary + recent turns (rolling window), suitable for agent hosts that don’t want to build this themselves. Should integrate with HMLR primitives (agent_events/bridge blocks) when persisting summaries.
acceptance_criteria: Helper accepts turn history and returns summary+retained window; budgeted output (max words/tokens); optional persistence path emits agent_events.

title: Add local agent console for mmry-service
description: Add an optional localhost-only web UI for mmry-service focused on agent workflows: view recent route results, agent event timeline, profile blocks, bridge blocks (open loops/decisions), facts, and service health/config flags.
acceptance_criteria: UI is optional and local-only; surfaces routing/context decisions and HMLR state; no sensitive data leaks by default (honor redaction).

title: Federated search across multiple mmry stores/instances
description: Allow an orchestrator to query across multiple mmry databases (e.g., one per sub-agent container) as if they were a single searchable corpus. Prefer a federation layer (fanout queries over HTTP/MCP and merge+rerank results with source metadata) over multi-tenant schema/auth in a single DB.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configured set of remotes, a single query returns merged results with stable schema including source (store/agent); fanout is parallel with per-remote timeouts; optional rerank over combined candidates; failures degrade gracefully.

title: Federation: config + remote registry
description: Add config schema for federated remotes (name, base_url, auth, default store/scope, timeouts). Provide a loader that resolves into store targets.
acceptance_criteria: Config parses; remotes validated; store target list produced deterministically.

title: Federation: mmry-service search endpoint
description: Expose a stable HTTP endpoint in mmry-service external API that returns ordered search results for a store (default store initially). Used by federation clients.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint exists under /v1/federation/search (or similar); supports query/category/limit/mode/rerank; enforces API key rules; tests verify behavior.

title: Federation: core fanout + merge (RRF)
description: Implement federated search in mmry-core: query multiple local stores and remote endpoints in parallel, merge via rank fusion (RRF) with per-source timeouts and stable source metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Federated search returns merged, source-tagged results; parallel fanout; per-remote timeout; tests cover merge ordering and failure handling.

title: Federation: CLI support (store scopes + output)
description: Extend mmry CLI to select one/many stores/remotes for search (and optionally ls), returning results annotated with source. Keep existing single-store behavior as default.
acceptance_criteria: CLI can search local default store, all local stores, or selected sources; JSON output includes source metadata; tests validate argument parsing and output shape.

title: Federation: TUI fuzzy picker for store scope
description: Add a fast fzf-like store scope picker in mmry-tui: type-to-filter + fuzzy match + multi-select to choose which local/remote stores are searched/browsed. Integrate store labels in list when multiple sources active.
acceptance_criteria: Picker filters interactively; supports multi-select; scope affects search results; tests cover fuzzy matching and selection logic.

title: Support remote embeddings backend (DB local)
description: Enable running mmry (CLI/service) with its SQLite DB inside a container while offloading embedding generation (and optionally reranking) to an external service for performance (GPU/accelerator). Add config to call remote /v1/embeddings (and /v1/rerank) instead of in-process/daemon, with timeouts, auth header, batching, and clear fallback behavior.
acceptance_criteria: New config selects embedding backend: local (default) or remote HTTP; ingestion and query embedding paths use remote when enabled; supports API key header + timeouts + max batch; behavior is cross-platform; tests cover fallback/error cases.

title: Smart ingest: dedupe chunks + fact fingerprints
description: Implement a smarter long-document ingestion: enforce min chunk size, optionally drop near-duplicate chunks, and dedupe extracted facts globally via fact_fingerprint unique key (backfilled + merged on upgrade). Also run HMLR enrichment on chunked ingest without producing duplicate facts.

title: Add verbose LLM request/response logging
description: Add structured tracing for LLM calls: log prompts sent, raw responses received, parse failures with raw response content. Use target='llm' for filtering. Add MMRY_LLM_DEBUG=1 env var to enable verbose mode.

title: Add HMLR documentation
description: Document HMLR features in README.md. Add usage guide showing manual memory creation with HMLR, search with facts, backfill command. Include migration guide for existing users. Add troubleshooting section.

title: Routing/ingestion API for agents
description: Expose CLI/RPC endpoints (e.g., mmry service route/add-turn) that return routing decisions, context ids, and fact hits for agent callers and record agent provenance.

title: after saving a memory in an external editor, the TUI is slightly broken, e.g. frame is missing
Run tests and fix warnings for async Analyzer trait
description: Local changes make Analyzer trait async. Need to run tests and fix any warnings/issues.

title: Add SQL offset support for memory list endpoint
description: memory_list_handler fetches limit+offset rows and then skips in memory. Update operations::list_memories (or add new query) to use LIMIT/OFFSET in SQL for better performance with large offsets (server.rs around memory list).

title: Guardrails: blocked patterns + safe regex matching
description: Add a configurable blocklist of patterns (literal + regex) that can suppress returning matching memories/facts in context packs and CLI search outputs (in addition to secret redaction). Include ReDoS-safe regex checks; expose `mmry guard add/list/remove` and include blocked-match warnings in JSON outputs.

title: HMLR-style integration tests for temporal and cross-topic invariants
description: Add Rust integration tests (CLI/service) that cover temporal ordering, cross-topic invariants, multi-hop recall, and sidecar-on/off behavior mirroring HMLR benchmarks.

title: Run tests and fix warnings for server.rs improvements
description: Local changes add /v1/models endpoint, async analyzer, timeouts, and validation tests.

title: Implement Scribe for async user profile updates
description: Create Scribe component that maintains user profile. Fire-and-forget async updates to user_profiles table. Extracts persistent user constraints and preferences from conversation. Updates profile JSON without blocking main flow.

title: Implement FactScrubber component
description: Create FactScrubber that extracts key-value facts from memory content. Uses Analyzer trait for LLM-backed extraction when enabled, falls back to heuristics when disabled. Stores extracted facts in SQL facts table.

title: Extend bridge block metadata with open_loops and decisions_made
description: Add open_loops and decisions_made fields to BridgeBlock struct. These track unresolved questions and key decisions within a conversation topic for better routing context.

title: Add domain continuity guidance to routing prompts
description: Update routing_prompt in prompts.rs with Sean-V-Dev's domain continuity rules: explicit 3-scenario framework (Continue LAST ACTIVE, Resume PAUSED, Start NEW), domain continuity examples (Docker->Docker Compose = SAME), and reasoning requirements.

title: Add RAGAS-style user invariant tests
description: Port HMLR's user invariant tests: vegetarian override (7B), cross-topic constraint persistence. Test that user preferences persist across topic changes and resist override attempts. Target 1.00 faithfulness and recall.

title: memory expiration time
description: memories should have an optional expiration date that can be infered by the llm during creation or explicitly set via the cli/tui. When a memory has expired, it is automatically marked as expired and excluded from searches unless explicitly set to --include-expired

title: Add LLM call timing and metrics
description: Add duration tracking for all LLM calls. Log elapsed time in ms. Consider adding success/failure counters for prompt effectiveness monitoring.

title: CLI doctor command (health checks + fix plan)
description: Add `mmry doctor` that checks DB schema, sqlite-vec, embeddings backend availability (local/remote), federation remotes reachability, config paths, and redaction settings. Support --json output, --fix with safe/cautious/manual fix levels, and --dry-run. Add tests for JSON shape and a few checks.

title: Fix mutex lock crash on CLI exit when using service mode
description: When running mmry search with service mode enabled, the CLI crashes on exit with 'libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::__1::system_error: mutex lock failed: Invalid argument'. This happens AFTER successful search results are displayed, during cleanup. Issue appears to be in fastembed/ort library cleanup code. The crash does NOT occur when service mode is disabled (direct embedding mode). Workaround attempted: using libc::_exit() to skip destructors, but needs libc dependency.

title: Add libc dependency for clean exit workaround
description: Add libc crate dependency to mmry-cli to enable using libc::_exit() as a workaround for the mutex crash on exit. This allows skipping Rust destructors and avoiding the fastembed/ort cleanup crash. Update Cargo.toml and replace std::process::exit() with unsafe { libc::_exit() }.

title: Protect console endpoints from unauthenticated access
description: Console endpoints are gated to localhost; if localhost access is trusted, this is lower risk. Consider keeping as-is or adding optional API-key enforcement for defense-in-depth.

title: Log parse failures with raw LLM response
description: When LLM response parsing fails (extract_facts, routing, filtering), log the raw response that caused the failure. Add tracing::warn with raw_response field for all parse failure paths in prompts.rs.

title: Memory ingest: novelty-based HMLR fact extraction for long docs
description: When ingesting chunked documents with HMLR enabled, avoid running fact extraction on redundant chunks by scoring chunk novelty (e.g., shingle/Jaccard vs previously processed chunks) and only enriching the top-N most novel chunks per document, while still storing all chunks for retrieval.

title: Review cass_memory_system feature set
description: Temporarily clone https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/cass_memory_system and extract feature ideas relevant to mmry (ingestion, dedupe, retrieval, eval/bench, UX). Translate into mmry beads tasks with acceptance criteria.

title: Background synthesis for bridge blocks
description: Implement periodic background task to condense long bridge blocks into summaries, update fact recency scores, close inactive blocks. Run via mmry service daemon mode. Add config for synthesis interval.

title: Handle corrupt rows without panicking
description: Memory row parsing unwraps UUID/timestamps; a single corrupt record crashes the process. Make deserialization fallible with surfaced errors and tests covering invalid data rows.

title: Fixed too_many_arguments warnings with options structs
description: Created ExecuteSearchOptions and SearchAllStoresOptions structs to replace functions with 8+ arguments. All clippy warnings now resolved.

title: Add HMLR integration tests
description: Create tests in crates/mmry-core/src/hmlr/mod.rs: test with HMLR enabled/disabled, fact extraction, bridge block creation, agent event logging. Test human agent tracking. Add regression test ensuring existing workflows unchanged when disabled.

title: Refactor to Governor orchestrator pattern
description: Refactor HmlrPipeline to Governor pattern with parallel execution. Implement tokio::join! for concurrent FactScrubber, Scribe, and LatticeCrawler tasks. Governor coordinates all components and makes routing decisions. See history/HMLR_COMPARISON.md for architecture details.

title: Abort federated search tasks after timeout
description: federation.rs wraps JoinHandle in timeout but doesn't abort timed-out tasks, leaving background work running. Abort or cancel timed-out tasks to avoid wasted resources.

title: Memory ingest: skip unchanged files via content hash
description: Implement --skip-existing for mmry ingest by storing source_path + content_hash metadata on parent/chunks, and skipping ingest when an identical file (or converted markdown) has already been ingested. Prefer a deterministic hash (blake3/sha256) stored in metadata and indexed for fast lookup.

title: Implement 2-key filtering for memory retrieval
description: Add 2-key filtering to Governor: validate vector similarity candidates against original query text. High similarity does NOT guarantee relevance (e.g., 'I love Python' vs 'I hate Python' = 95% similar but opposite). Add LLM-based filtering step after vector search.

title: Background synthesis and rehydration for bridge blocks
description: Schedule synthesis/eviction jobs in mmry service to condense spans into bridge-block summaries, update fact recency, and rehydrate on Governor selection without blocking CLI performance.

title: External API auth option and OpenAI-style embeddings endpoints
description: Allow users to expose the external HTTP API without a key by default, but add optional API-key enforcement (Bearer) and OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoints; document host/port bind expectations and ensure rejecting malformed/absent keys when opt-in auth is enabled.

title: Scoped profile blocks + directory ingest
description: Add block scoping (global/project/agent) to profile blocks across core/CLI/MCP/service, plus a directory ingest that chunks files into deterministic scoped blocks.

title: Update tests + clippy for scoped blocks
description: Ensure new scoped blocks + ingest have robust unit tests and clippy passes with -D warnings.

title: Implement directory ingest into profile blocks
description: Add a deterministic directory ingest that reads text files, strips YAML frontmatter, chunks into max_block_chars blocks, and writes scoped profile blocks.

title: Add ProfileBlockScope and update APIs
description: Introduce ProfileBlockScope (global/project/agent), plumb through core + CLI + service + MCP, and adjust write APIs to include scope.

title: Display HMLR enrichments in TUI detail pane
description: Update crates/mmry-tui/src/ui/right_pane.rs to show HMLR enrichments when viewing a memory: bridge block info, extracted facts, creator agent. Only display if HMLR data exists for the memory.

title: Add chunk-level provenance to facts
description: Link extracted facts to sentence-level chunks for precise provenance: source_chunk_id, source_paragraph_id, evidence_snippet fields. Requires chunking integration with fact extraction.

title: Optional mmry-agents sidecar for Governor routing and hydration
description: Build a companion service that reuses mmry store/service, runs HMLR-style routing/hydration with local-first models via Rig (gguf/local-first with optional remote fallback), and exposes a minimal API to agents.

title: Add CLI search flag for HMLR mode
description: Add --hmlr and --include-facts flags to crates/mmry-cli/src/commands/search.rs. When enabled, use search_with_hmlr() and display facts and bridge block groupings in output.

title: Reuse reqwest client in JsonHttpClient helper
description: http_json.rs builds a new reqwest::Client per request; reuse a shared client (or inject one) to reduce connection setup overhead and improve performance.

title: Clarify JSON consumers for mmry search output
description: Identify internal/external consumers of mmry search --json output and federation JSON so we know whether wrapping results in {memories, guardrails} is acceptable or needs versioning/flag.

title: Local-LLM prompt set for facts and routing
description: Prototype deterministic prompts for fact extraction and Governor routing using a small local Rig-managed model; log decisions and costs; fall back gracefully when no model is configured.

title: Add HMLR-enhanced search functionality

title: Enhanced export/import with HMLR data for cross-machine sync
description:
## Problem
Current mmry export only includes memories. For cross-machine sync via git, we need to also export HMLR enrichment data (facts, bridge_blocks, entities, relationships) so the full knowledge graph is portable.

## Proposed Export Format
```json
{
  "exported_at": "2025-12-25T...",
  "store": "govnr",
  "version": 2,
  "memory_count": 13,
  "memories": [...],  // existing format
  "hmlr": {
    "facts": [
      {
        "id": "...",
        "fact_key": "...",
        "fact_value": "...",
        "category": "Definition|Acronym|Secret|Entity|General",
        "evidence_snippet": "...",
        "source_chunk_id": "...",
        "fact_fingerprint": "...",
        "observed_at": "..."
      }
    ],
    "bridge_blocks": [
      {
        "block_id": "...",
        "span_id": "...",
        "topic_label": "...",
        "keywords": [...],
        "status": "active",
        "open_loops": [...],
        "decisions_made": [...],
        "memory_ids": [...],
        "created_at": "..."
      }
    ],
    "entities": [
      {
        "id": "...",
        "name": "...",
        "type": "...",
        "metadata": {}
      }
    ],
    "relationships": [
      {
        "id": "...",
        "from_entity": "...",
        "to_entity": "...",
        "relation_type": "...",
        "strength": 1.0
      }
    ],
    "memory_entities": [
      {"memory_id": "...", "entity_id": "..."}
    ]
  }
}
```

## What NOT to export
- Embeddings (recomputed on each machine)
- Agent events/agents table (local to each machine)

## Import behavior
1. Upsert memories by ID (skip if exists with same updated_at)
2. Upsert facts by fact_fingerprint (dedupe)
3. Upsert bridge_blocks by block_id
4. Upsert entities by name (case-insensitive)
5. Upsert relationships by id
6. Rebuild memory_entities links
7. Trigger re-embedding for new memories

## CLI
```bash
mmry export -o file.json --include-hmlr  # default: include hmlr
mmry export -o file.json --no-hmlr       # memories only (current behavior)
mmry import file.json                     # new command
mmry import file.json --dry-run          # show what would be imported
```

## Integration with byt sync
byt sync push/pull will use this enhanced format automatically.

title: Optional ingestr conversion for profile blocks ingest

title: Add HmlrConfig to core config

title: HMLR backfill duplicates memories by calling memory creation endpoint
description: In hmlr.rs backfill command, when service_client is available it calls client.enrich_memory() which posts to /v1/agents/memories endpoint. This endpoint (agent_memory_create_handler in server.rs) CREATES a new memory via operations::insert_memory() instead of enriching an existing one. Each backfill run doubles the memory count: 84->168->336. Fix: The backfill should use the local HmlrPipeline.enrich_memory() for existing memories, which correctly enriches without duplicating. Remove service API path from backfill or create a dedicated enrich-only endpoint.

title: Add agent memory creation to service API
description: Add endpoint to crates/mmry-service/src/server.rs for agent memory creation. Include conversation_history in HmlrContext for intelligent bridge block routing. Use LLM-backed analyzer when configured.

title: Input limits and timeouts for external API
description: Add request size and batch caps plus timeouts for embeddings/rerank/agent routes to prevent unbounded model work; validate limits with clear 400 errors and tests ensuring excessive input is rejected early.

title: Add VLM/OCR support to ingestr for image-based documents
description: Add composable VLM/OCR pipeline to ingestr for processing images and scanned PDFs. Should be modular: 1) Optional OCR backend (tesseract, etc.) 2) Optional VLM backend (local models, API) 3) Configurable per file type 4) Output same markdown+frontmatter format for mmry compatibility

title: Update example config with HMLR section
description: Add [hmlr] section to examples/config.toml with all configuration options documented. Include commented examples for typical use cases. Set enabled=false by default.

title: Add RAGAS-style temporal conflict tests
description: Port HMLR's temporal conflict tests: API key rotation (7A), timestamp updates (7C). Test that newest facts override older ones deterministically. Verify 1.00 faithfulness and recall. See HMLR test suite for reference scenarios.

title: Procedural rules with feedback + decay (optional)
description: Consider a first-class procedural memory layer (rules/anti-patterns) inspired by cass-memory: rules have scope, maturity, helpful/harmful feedback events, decay half-life, conflict detection, and anti-pattern inversion. Expose via CLI and include in context packs. Keep optional via cargo feature or config gate to avoid overcomplication.

title: Integrate HMLR benchmarks into mmry dev/CI
description: Port or mirror the HMLR/RAGAS benchmark corpus, add a local harness runnable against mmry core and mmry+sidecar, and track faithfulness/recall/precision over changes.

title: Service mode is slow: CLI takes 3.6s per search despite using daemon
description: Service mode embeddings work correctly (daemon embed successful in ~50ms), but overall search still takes 3.6 seconds real time with 30+ seconds CPU time. The CLI creates SparseEmbeddingService and RerankerService on every invocation even when not used for semantic-only searches. These services use OnceCell for lazy loading, but since new instances are created each CLI run, they may be initializing resources. Need to investigate: 1) Where the 3.6s real time is spent (DB init? search query?), 2) Whether sparse/reranker should also go through service daemon, 3) Whether they should be created conditionally based on search mode.

title: Run tests and fix warnings for robust DB operations
description: Local changes add robust error handling in operations.rs. Need to verify tests pass.

title: Wire HMLR hook into TUI add memory
description: Integrate HmlrPipeline::enrich_memory() into crates/mmry-tui/src/app.rs add_memory() method after operations::insert_memory(). Use NoOpAnalyzer for TUI. Create HmlrContext with human agent ID.

title: mmry should auto-create store based on git repo when running from project directory
description: When running 'mmry add' from a directory inside a git repo, mmry should: 1) Detect git repo name from remote origin or directory name, 2) Auto-create a store with that name if it doesn't exist, 3) Use that store for the operation. Currently falls back to default store if no --store flag provided and store doesn't exist.
